lines: Don't leave me alone in the Birch Forest. It is too easy to lose you between all those pale trunks.
The Birch Forest looked calm right up until I realized I was standing there by myself.
I waited in the Birch Forest listening for your steps and hearing everything except you.
A Birch Forest feels much less friendly when I am the one left behind in it.
Those white trunks made every path look the same after a while.
I kept turning in circles, hoping one of the gaps between the trees would show you coming back.
Please do not leave me somewhere the forest can hide you that quickly.
The Birch Forest was quiet, but not in a comforting way.
I could see through the trees, just not far enough to feel safe.
I was alone under those pale branches, wondering which way you had gone.
